name: AiSync Hermes
description: Connect Omi memories, live transcripts, raw audio bytes, daily summaries, and Chat Tools to a user-owned Hermes agent through the AiSync telemetry bridge.
setup_instructions: Install the app, add your Hermes receiver URL or AiSync account connection, and enable the webhook surfaces you want. Omi audio and transcripts are treated as read-only context by default; commands require chat-tool intent or explicit promotion.
privacy_summary: The app stores event metadata and extracted text by default. Full webhook payloads and raw audio storage are disabled unless explicitly enabled by the deployment owner for a short debug window.
